findings.title: Levels 99 and 100 cannot be cleared by any tier, including superhuman
findings.detail: superhuman (perfect information, frame-exact rollouts) failed L99 3/3 (boss left at 86-96% HP, dies within 82-154 s) and L100 3/3 (boss 90-95% HP). world/skilled/casual/clumsy lose all lives in L99/L100 waves within 10-77 s. Cause: compound per-level growth — enemy fire rate and HP G(1.022)^99 ≈ 8.6x (index.html:381-382), boss HP 200*1.028^99*1.5 ≈ 4.6k (index.html:385), plus BLOB triple shot from L50 (index.html:714). At L75 the same superhuman clears in 175 s, so the jump 75→99 is well past the skill ceiling.
findings.fix: Cap frate/hpm growth after ~L60 (e.g. Math.min(G(1.022),4)) and size bossMax so maximum player DPS (power 4) kills it in ~60-90 s; verify the superhuman/world bot clears L100.

findings.title: Difficulty wall between L50 and L75
findings.detail: world clears L50 first try (102 s, no deaths) but fails L75 3/3 (boss best 30% left); skilled needs 3 tries for L50 and fails L75 3/3 (boss 86% left). Only superhuman clears L75. Stacked: fire rate ~5x, triple shot (index.html:714), last wave forced to the toughest template from L50 (index.html:436).
findings.repro: node bot.js world 75 ; node bot.js skilled 50,75
findings.fix: Slow frate growth after L50, or phase in the triple shot gradually (e.g. probability rising from L60).

findings.title: Early curve too steep for low tiers
findings.detail: clumsy clears L1 only on its 2nd attempt (1st: dies at boss with 45% HP left) and fails L10 5/5 (boss 29-65% left) and everything above. casual clears L1 (losing 2 of 3 lives at the boss) and L10, then fails L25 3/3 (dies at boss) and L50/75 3/3 within ~35 s in the waves. Nearly all low-tier deaths happen at the boss of early levels: the L1 boss uses aimed fan + ring bullets.
findings.repro: node bot.js clumsy 1,10 ; node bot.js casual 25
findings.fix: Bosses of levels 1-10 use one slow pattern; or give extra lives / keep power on hit in early levels.

findings.title: Late boss fights are long grinds
findings.detail: superhuman needs 99 s for L50 and 175 s for L75; most of the time is spent chipping boss HP, which grows x1.028/level, faster than player firepower (startPower caps at 4, index.html:388).
findings.fix: Lower boss HP growth to ~1.018/level or scale player fire rate with level.

findings.title: No <!doctype> and no viewport meta
findings.detail: index.html starts with a <style id="mobile-shim"> block; there is no doctype and no <meta name=viewport>. Opened directly on a phone (390 px) the page lays out at 980 px and is scaled down ~2.5x (tiny controls/text) and renders in quirks mode. Inside game-hub's iframe it is fine because the host supplies the viewport.
findings.repro: Open apps/doodle-shooter/index.html directly in a 390x844 mobile emulation; window.innerWidth === 980.
findings.fix: Add <!doctype html> and <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"> at the top.

harness: Mobile 390x844 DPR2 hasTouch isMobile; game served inside a hub-like host page (<!doctype>+viewport meta, full-screen iframe — same as game-hub's iframe embedding) because the file itself has no doctype/viewport. Read-only state getter inserted into the served copy (file on disk untouched). Lock-step clock, seeded Math.random, single-finger relative drag. Cap 240 s per attempt (superhuman L75/99/100: 360 s). Because superhuman failed 99/100, other tiers ran 1 attempt at 99/100 (HARD_ATT=1). 0 page/console errors in all runs.
